name: Golden A/S Employee
subtitle: My leave, requests and HR
promotionalText: Clock in and out, your leave balances, leave requests, training and messages from HR — for the staff of Golden A/S.
description:
Golden A/S Employee is the app of the staff of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An employee account issued by Golden A/S is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it every employee can:
• clock in and out at the start and end of work; the position is taken once, at that moment, and is not tracked in between
• see the leave balances of the year: entitled, taken, pending, available
• ask for leave, by day or by hour, with a reason and a supporting document
• join a company leave period, such as the Christmas closure
• follow each request: waiting for the manager, waiting for HR, approved or rejected
• see training opportunities and apply
• read and acknowledge evaluations
• exchange private messages with the HR office

Requests are decided by the manager and by HR in the company portal; the app shows the answer.

The app works in English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian and Bulgarian. It can be locked with Face ID or fingerprint.
whatsNew: First release of Golden A/S Employee: clock in and out with position, leave balances, leave requests with documents, company leave periods, training and HR messages.
reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Attached in the Attachment field of this App Review Information section (GoldenEmployee_review_recording.mp4). Recorded on a physical iPhone with the demonstration account; it shows: launch from the home screen, sign-in with e-mail and password, In / Out with a clock-in (location prompt) and a clock-out, My HR with the leave balances, a leave request sent, the Requests list, Training, HR messages with a message sent, More (language, Face ID on open), Lock app and unlock with Face ID, and sign-out.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Golden A/S Employee is the internal staff app of Golden A/S (Golden Automation Systems), a marine electrical and automation company based in Piraeus, Greece. It is used only by the company's employees. It lets each employee see the own leave balances, ask for leave, join company leave periods, apply for training, acknowledge evaluations and write to the HR office, without opening the company web portal. It is not intended for the general public.

3. ACCESS
Sign in with the demo account given in the App Review Information section (a demonstration account: it opens invented data only, what is done there stays on the device; no authenticator code is needed). Tabs: My HR, In / Out and More. In / Out registers the start and end of work: when the button is pressed the app asks for the location once (When In Use) and sends the time and that single position to the company server; there is no background location and no tracking. Inside My HR: Leave, Requests, Training, HR messages. The app has no account registration: accounts are created by the company administrator in the company portal, so there is no in-app account creation or deletion. An employee's account is closed by the administrator when employment ends.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
The app talks only to Golden A/S's own server (https://www.goldensas.com) over HTTPS. No third-party analytics, advertising, payment, AI or data-provider service is used. Sign-in uses the company's own accounts, with optional authenticator (TOTP) and passkeys. Face ID / Touch ID is used on the device only. The link "Open in Google Maps" on an entry opens Google Maps in the browser with the stored coordinates; nothing else is sent to Google.

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Languages: English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
None. The app contains no third-party protected material, no purchases and no paid content. Personnel data belongs to Golden A/S and is processed under its privacy policy: https://www.goldenas.com.gr/privacy.html

USER CONTENT
Messages are exchanged only between the signed-in employee and the company's HR office; there is no public content.
